theme_central: Oaths by Mount Sinai and other cosmic realities to establish the inevitability of the Judgment, then a methodical refutation of the accusations brought against the Prophet.
sources_note: 2-section structure precisely sourced (quranoasis.com, thelastdialogue.org): 1-28 (the Hereafter), 29-49 (refutation of the accusations).

branches.title: Oaths
branches.resume: Oaths by the Mount, the inscribed Book, the frequented House, the raised roof, the raging sea.

children.t: Oaths by Mount Sinai, the inscribed Book, the raging sea

branches.title: Inevitable punishment
branches.resume: Nothing can prevent the punishment of those who doubted the Judgment.

children.t: Inevitable punishment of those who doubted the Judgment

branches.title: Reward of the believers
branches.resume: Description of Paradise for the believers and their offspring who join them in faith.

children.t: Paradise of the believers, reunited with their believing offspring

branches.title: Refutation of the accusations
branches.resume: The Prophet is neither a soothsayer, nor a madman, nor a poet; challenge to produce a similar discourse.

children.t: Refutation of the accusations, challenge to produce a similar discourse

branches.title: Rational argument of creation
branches.resume: Created from nothing, or self-creators? Do they possess the treasures of Allah?

children.t: Created from nothing or self-creators? Allah's treasures beyond their reach

branches.title: Persistent blindness, final patience
branches.resume: Even seeing a piece of the sky fall, they would not believe; patience and glorification asked of the Prophet.

children.t: Persistent blindness even before a clear sign; the Prophet's final patience
